meta.name: live_database_ingest
meta.description: Capture semantic-layer and knowledge updates from a live database schema snapshot.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从数据库实时捕获语义层与知识更新
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在数据库变更时自动更新知识层
copy.tagline_en: Capture semantic-layer and knowledge updates from live database schema
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automatically update knowledge layer on database changes

howto.what: Claude 能读取数据库快照文件，自动为表创建或更新语义层，并保留数据库注释。它还会验证标识符是否存在，避免使用虚构的表名。
howto.when: 当工作单元中包含 raw-sources/<connectionId>/live-database/<syncId>/ 下的原始文件时触发。

say.text: 帮我从数据库快照中导入订单表。
say.note: Claude 会读取 orders 表并创建语义层源。

say.text: 检查一下用户表的外键关系。

howto.what_en: Claude reads database snapshot files, creates or updates semantic-layer sources for tables, preserves database comments, and verifies identifiers before writing to avoid fictional table names.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the work unit contains raw files under raw-sources/<connectionId>/live-database/<syncId>/.

say_en.text: Import the orders table from the database snapshot.
say_en.note: Claude will read the orders table and create a semantic-layer source.

say_en.text: Check foreign key relationships for the users table.
say_en.note: Claude will read foreign-keys.json and add necessary joins.
